sect2.title: Slackware64 package
sect2.para: The Slackware package installs vera with the default configuration options. The package's installation script automatically runs the inittab command that reads /etc/inittab and /etc/rc.d/rc?.d and converts them to vera's unit specifications. The script fails if it doesn't understand them. Install the Slackware 15 package with installpkg and follow the instructions above starting with the vlad hookonce command.

sect2.title: Known issues on Slackware 15
sect2.para: Shutdowns take a few more seconds to complete. /etc/rc.d/rc.M runs /etc/rc.d/rc.script start commands, but /etc/rc.d/rc.K runs only a handful of /etc/rc.d/rc.script stops, and skips most of them. /etc/rc.d/rc.K takes the easy way out that simply kilalls all processes.

vera inittab converts each rc.script to a unit, and the unit formally runs rc.script start and rc.script stop. Stopping each unit takes additional time. This also exposes a rc.networkmanager issue with its default DHCP configuration that uses dhcpcd: there's a ten second delay in the middle of every shutdown, with vera waiting for one dhcpcd process to stop. This appears to be a dhcpcd glitch. This gets covered up normally by rc.K terminating all processes at once, but gets exposed when NetworkManager runs in a container.
This does not happen with dhcp=dhclient in /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/00-dhcp-client.conf.
